status: documented fields only; no validator in this scaffold

upstream.note: Field roles follow sayframe source-bound directions. Names and the confirm gate are TalkCut's.

gate: Stage 1 may only save proposals. No rough cut, motion, cover, or export until the user confirms one direction.
workflow: import/read, then methodology plus transcript, then propose. Wait for the user. choose-plan comes after confirmation.

proposal.sourceSha256: hash of the imported media or the transcript bundle for this read

directions.id: short unique id, lowercase, stable inside this proposal
directions.title: accurate title within 48 characters; do not invent spoken lines
directions.journey_role: why_need | why_me | why_now | need_education | trust_conversion | reach_breakout
directions.audience: who this cut is for; say unknown when unsure
directions.goal: the single job of this cut

hook_candidate.text: verbatim span from the current read
segmentIds: real segment ids covering that span

directions.opening_style: 提问式 | 讲故事 | 笃定式 | 对比式 | 夸张式 | 纠正式 | 喊话式

support_blocks.reason: why these lines are one support unit

cta.patternId: one of cta_patterns ids, or null

cut_candidates.reason: why this span is a candidate, not yet a cut

order: kept segment ids in proposed picture order; each id once; no timestamps

evidence.id: each id in order exactly once
evidence.quote: full verbatim segment text; do not paraphrase

gaps: missing proof, missing CTA, or facts to check; never describe a gap as done
directions.why: why this direction and this order

constraints: Offer 1 to 4 directions. Do not pad the list, and do not file two directions with the same order.
Every quote and segment id comes from the current read. Do not invent lines, speakers, or timestamps.
The hook should land in the first 3 seconds of the proposed cut. Do not split a semantic unit only to hit that mark.
Saving a proposal does not change the current edit. choose-plan is reversible once the engine exists.
A newer read invalidates saved proposals.
